Subarnarekha Valley Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/9/2015/132 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Patch Repair - Delhi Pkg-132" (roads maintenance), awarded to M/s
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
 all respects on 2015-02-17 at a gross executed value of INR 2,04,00,000/- (Rupees 2.04 Crore Only).
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Imran Joshi. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Subarnarekha Valley Corporation
